a_codeAudit.finding: `advantaged()` is consumed ONLY by the damage multiplier and a reported field — no gauge, cadence, rotation or trigger path. The other two sites are GENERAL primitives that COULD reach gauge, so the packet's 'element enters ONLY the elem multiplier' wording is not literally true of the engine; it is true of THIS ROSTER. Verified per unit: none of rouge / trina / scarlet-black-shadow / liberalio / soda-twinkling-bunny carries a bossElementGate or a bossElement trigger. trina's `alliesOfElementWeapon: Electric AR` targets the ALLY's element, not the boss's, and is element-invariant.

C2_fullBurstDuration.preRegistered: every cycle must read 15.0 +/- 0.5s; >2 cycles outside => BASIS-BROKEN (C2 binds over B3 per packet section G)
C2_fullBurstDuration.instrumentCaveat: The drain-bar renderer UNDER-RENDERS: on the two committed 10.0s-Full-Burst fixtures a true 10.0s window reads a median 8.69s (u8-g-iron-sweep) / 8.755s (probe-u7-t5-wind-weak). A raw fullWindows[] duration is therefore a LOWER bound on the Full Burst, never a measurement of it. The charging bar's first paint (barPaint) is the matching UPPER bound. Both bounds are corrected for guard 3A's late start. Four readings are reported; the pre-registered rule is applied to each, and no reading is preferred here.
C2_fullBurstDuration.guard3bUnusableOnThisArm: cycle-table.ts DEFAULTS.searchCapSec = 11s, so guard 3B's corrected duration SATURATES at 11.000s on 9 of 10 N3 cycles and every cycle is flagged tailStitched. Raising the cap to 18s was tried and REJECTED: it re-admits stitched tails on the calibration fixtures (iron cycle 4 8.683 -> 14.100s, T5 cycle 5 8.350 -> 16.133s), so the default is kept and guard-3B corrected durations are treated as unavailable for this arm.

structuralObservation.claim: the closure residual is INVARIANT under any uniform rescaling of sumRealDelta, so variant (b) can never differ from the as-specified value on any arm
structuralObservation.algebra: oEff = oTime * (M / eventMass) / massCorrSim is proportional to M; rho = (M / sumRealDur) / simRate is proportional to M; residual = |oEff*S - rho| / rho = |k*S - c| / c, with M cancelling.

anomaliesAndFindings.finding: The E.3 paired diagnostic's three pre-committed clauses all presuppose BOTH arms failing closure as-specified. N3 PASSES closure (0.0533). No clause matches on its own terms; the nearest (SPLIT => inconclusive on R2) is recorded. Additionally, the closure residual is algebraically INVARIANT under uniform rescaling of sumRealDelta, so variant (b) is identically equal to the as-specified value on every arm and can never move a verdict — confirmed numerically on both arms.

C2 is the only control whose verdict depends on which reading of 'measure the real Full Burst duration' is taken, and the four readings SPLIT (2 PASS / 2 BASIS-BROKEN). Root cause: the drain-bar renderer under-renders by ~1.3s and the packet did not pin an estimator. Both PASS readings rest on the barPaint upper bound, whose calibration constant on the committed 10.0s iron fixture is 0.3193 +/- 0.0062 s (n=12); both BASIS-BROKEN readings rest on the rendered lower bound, whose iron calibration spread is 0.20 s sd with every N3 cycle flagged tailStitched and guard 3B cap-saturated. Reported without preference.

10.0s lies BELOW every N3 cycle's lower bound (minimum correctedRendered 12.78s), so the fixture positively excludes an unextended 10s Full Burst on this recording. Independent corroboration of packet P4's +5s premise WITHOUT relying on the sim: the analyze closure block reports realLadderSec 6.684s against the engine's 1.867s, and that block hardcodes FB_SEC = 10 (fill-trace-compare.ts:436) — 6.684 - 5.0 = 1.684s, i.e. the 5s discrepancy is exactly the unmodeled Full-Burst extension.

cycle-table.ts DEFAULTS.searchCapSec = 11s cannot host a ~15s Full Burst: guard 3B saturates at the cap on 9/10 N3 cycles and marks every cycle tailStitched, making its corrected duration and its tailStitched flag uninformative on this arm. Raising the cap to 18s was tried and REJECTED because it re-admits stitched tails on the two calibration fixtures. Not fixed here (out of scope); reported.

Window pairing: the real fixture yields 9 refill windows, the sim schedule 8 non-truncated refill windows, so real window 9 is dropped as 'no sim refill window with this ordinal'. Window 8 is dropped separately at 53.7% clean-bin coverage (< 60%). 7 windows survive to the pooled statistic. This is the -1 full-burst gap (packet P2) manifesting in the pairing; ordinal pairing is what classifyArm does and is pre-registered.

C7 co-occurrence runs OPPOSITE on the two arms: N3's bridged spans sit on 0.757x the modeled fill rate of its unbridged spans (bias direction DOWNWARD), iron's on 1.357x (bias direction UPWARD). Bridged mass is 9.6% of sumRealDelta on N3 vs 14.0% on iron; bridged real time is 9.5% of window time on both. Descriptive; the packet attaches no verdict.

The MAR-alternative full-window denominator reproduces the standing caveat and is WORSE on this arm: N3's raw rate under it is 4.5641/s, 11.0% BELOW its raw ceiling (iron's was 5.7% below). The excess on both arms exists only under the clean-bin-time estimator.

The realised event count is 69, not the ~178 the pre-run power estimate assumed, so the realised H1-vs-R1 separation is 0.59 sigma rather than 0.98. The pre-committed non-discrimination consequence is unchanged, only strengthened.

scan.ts reported 2 orphan stage-3 hexagon events (videoT 54.4 and 90.85) matching no Full Burst window. The Full-Burst count is unaffected (10, 10/10 corroborated by a second detector). Recorded, not acted on.

The packet's C1 wording, 'boss element enters ONLY the elem damage multiplier and no gauge, cadence, rotation or trigger path', is not literally true of the ENGINE: `bossElementGate` (sim.ts:2498) and the `bossElement` trigger kind (sim.ts:3380) are general primitives that could gate any effect including a gauge effect. It IS true of this roster (no N3 unit uses either), and the empirical swap confirms zero gauge/FB movement across all six element arms.
